card.name: Articles before quantity or abstract nouns
card.fires_on: Small words like "an", "a" and "is", or adjectives such as "large" and "double", that come just before a noun of quantity or a collective noun (infinity, harvest, number, community). Mostly in essay-style or older prose.

modes.label: Article before quantity noun
modes.description: "a" or "an" right before a word for amount or abundance.
modes.example: a choice from among<< an>> infinity of laws all of which enjoy the

modes.label: Adjective before a count word
modes.description: A size or degree adjective that leads into "number" or a similar noun.
modes.example: A<< large>> number of new amino acids have been isolated

modes.label: Linking word before a description
modes.description: A verb or article that introduces a general characterization.
modes.example: The family is<< a>> community, an initiation into life in society

card.writes: It slightly promotes "basic" and "information" type words, which suggests a push toward general, generic nouns.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a general or collective noun, like "a" in "a large harvest".
